design.purpose: A decorative six-pointed snowflake for a window, made by one adult or older child

steps.c: Place the 21 cm square sheet flat
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°
Cut across the wide end of the wedge
Cut a notch from one side of the wedge
Cut a notch from the other side of the wedge
Cut a small notch near the wide end
Open the sheet out flat to reveal snowflake
